name: Evermore Bridge
source:
Your best friend went missing, and you're to blame.
...Or at least that's how you feel.
Return to the town you left years ago, join the vampire hunters, and try to find her... and maybe fall in love along the way.
But be careful.
Anyone who lives in this town... Will die here too.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250831035455/https://violentbunnies.itch.io/evermore-bridge]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你最好的朋友失踪了，而这一切都怪你。
……至少你是这么觉得的。
重返你多年前离开的小镇，加入吸血鬼猎人的行列，设法寻回她的踪迹……或许还能在途中邂逅一段恋情。
但务必当心。
凡是生活在这座小镇里的人……最终也会死在这里。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250831035455/https://violentbunnies.itch.io/evermore-bridge]itch.io[/url]]
